title: Split plugin integration tests by registry, filters, loader, manifest, SDK, sandbox, and tool behavior
description: Plugin tests now cover registry ordering, filters, manifest/SDK, loader lifecycle, dependencies, hot reload, extensions, sandbox decisions, and tool execution in one file. Split them before Star parity adds dynamic loading and Python compatibility tests.

files.change: Hold shared fixtures and import behavior-specific plugin test modules.
Move existing tests by subsystem without behavior changes.

criteria: Existing plugin tests are behavior-preserving after the split.
Future loader/sandbox/tool tests have dedicated modules.
No plugin runtime behavior changes are included.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo clippy -p astrbot-plugin -- -D warnings
